newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending three-session loss.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending three-session loss.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall for the fourth consecutive session as Poland's largest commercial bank Bank Handlowy SA was drawing funds away from the exchange with an offer on the primary market, analysts said.
They said, however, the bourse was likely to slow its falls and stabilise in coming sessions, as the recent slide could spur some demand.

Construction company Unibud SA starts trade on the main market on Tuesday and analysts expect it to rise on its debut as its issue price of 15 zlotys would make it trade at a big discount to currently listed construction firms.
